title: openOODA Package Manager
content:
## opm — Package Manager

`opm` is the openOODA package manager. It ships inside the `ooda` toolchain and handles install, search, publish, lock, init, and audit for the openOODA package ecosystem.

### Install

opm ships with the ooda toolchain. Once you have `ooda` on PATH, you have `opm`.

```sh
# Install the toolchain (one-time)
oodaup install ooda@2.10.0

# Add a package
opm install openOODA/std

# Search
opm search capability
```

### 19 Subcommands

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `opm add` | Add a dependency to the manifest |
| `opm audit` | Verify installed packages against the lock |
| `opm bot` | Bot automation entry |
| `opm cat` | Print a package's manifest |
| `opm git` | Git-based source control for packages |
| `opm ingest` | Ingest a local directory as a package |
| `opm init` | Initialize a new package in the current dir |
| `opm io` | I/O introspection |
| `opm launch` | Launch a packaged application |
| `opm more` | Additional utility commands |
| `opm ops` | Operational commands (publish, retract, etc.) |
| `opm pack` | Pack a directory into a tarball |
| `opm pick` | Pick a specific version from a range |
| `opm pkg` | Package-level operations |
| `opm publish` | Publish a package to the registry |
| `opm reg` / `registry` | Registry operations |
| `opm regs` | Registry status |
| `opm search` | Search the registry |
| `opm tree` | Print the dependency tree |

### Version semantics

- `^1.2.3` — compatible with 1.x.y, >= 1.2.3
- `~1.2.3` — patch-level changes only, >= 1.2.3, < 1.3.0
- `1.2.3` — exact version
- `*` — latest

Lock file (`opm.lock`) pins exact versions and content hashes. `opm audit` verifies the lock against installed packages.

### Version contract

```
opm=0.7.0
api_surface=10
```

### Stock registry

`https://registry.openooda.org` — CAS-by-sha, capability declarations on every package, zero ambient supply chain.

Full docs: [github.com/openOODA/opm/tree/main/docs](https://github.com/openOODA/opm/tree/main/docs)
